arms.bind@rho0.3_all, bind@rho0.5_all, bind@r: the same, with the action expert's attention (all 18 layers, every Euler step) raised to mass rho on the agent-view tokens of the current phase's referent: the moved object while the policy's own commanded gripper is open, the target while closed; ORACLE maps (simulator segmentation, coverage >= 0.1 per token) sent by the client (--seg)
arms.bindplacebo@rho0.5_all: the same bias toward a random OTHER movable object, fixed per episode (steerability: does the policy pick the object it is biased toward?)
arms.zs: pi0.5 under the task's own instruction, unbiased

metrics.choice_for_Q2: the rho with the highest mean BA among those meeting NONE <= 0.2 on every task (ties: the smaller rho)
metrics.episodes: 10 per arm and task, practice init states 0-9, client --bind stop (the episode ends at the first binding)
metrics.excluded_configs_rule: a config that experiments/b2_steer_offline.py flags as overriding (OS or LS median < 0.5 on class_a) is dropped from this read before it runs
metrics.kill: binding cannot be injected (BIND stops) unless, for some rho, BA >= 0.5 on at least 2 of the 4 tasks with NONE <= 0.2 on those tasks
metrics.measure: BA = share of episodes whose first movable object displaced > 3 cm while the commanded gripper is closed is the goal's moved instance; NONE = share binding nothing before the step limit; for the placebo arm, the share binding the placebo object
